check_priority.note: Round 3 program-check card priority. Shaped as a rules.json key: merge `check_priority` into rules.json as-is. Card order (CoS call 2026-10-23): state first (red, then amber), score only within a state; info items never show on the card (they stay in the full analysis); red / amber always show (no minimum score) and an issue without a validated fix shows with action see_analysis instead of Apply. Cap 3; a board with no red / amber issue shows none. score = severity x importance x fixability; importance = check weight x muscle weight. Design choices, not evidence; scores are a model. Reference: tools/check_priority.py; spec: data/check-priority-spec.md; fixture: data/check-priority-reference.json.

severity.rule: severity = lo + (hi - lo) * d, where [lo, hi] = state_band[state] and d in [0, 1] is the distance from range (see distance). red = a failing check (non-info flag); amber = close to target (weekly_band, stretch share below 0.25); info = an info note.

distance.session_hard_sets: info: (sets - (cap - info_band)) / info_band; warn: min(1, (sets - cap) / cap)
distance.push_pull_imbalance: min(1, distance of the ratio outside 0.75-2.0 / 0.75)

importance.rule: check_weight[family] * muscle_weight[muscle] (board-level issues use muscle weight 1.0)

weekly_volume.note: weekly sets per muscle: the main lever

stretch.note: per-muscle stretch checks; low share (amber) for checked or measure-only muscles

frequency.note: scheduling suggestion only (volume-equated studies find little effect)

importance.muscle_weight_rationale: Big prime movers that carry most of a physique and most weekly sets (chest, back, quads, glutes, hamstrings) = 1.0. Delts and arms, which the app targets directly and users notice, 0.75-0.85; front delts 0.6 because pressing already covers them. Calves 0.7. Muscles that mostly get indirect work or small targets (traps, abs, adductors, obliques, abductors, lower back, forearms) 0.4-0.6. A design choice for ordering the card, not evidence about which muscles matter more. The app has no neck muscle.

rules.when: a validated fix resolves the issue with one op (sets, swap, add or move one tile)
a validated fix resolves it with two ops
a validated fix resolves it with three or more ops
only partial fixes (move toward the goal without meeting it)
no validated fix: needs restructuring by hand

fixability.source: the validated fixes of tools/analysis.py sheet() (suggestions.validation: never adds a non-info flag, so every fix stays within session limits)

excluded_sources.lower_fatigue_swap: An optimisation, not a check: it never appears on the program-check card (it stays in the Recovery & fatigue suggestions).

check_priority.dedupe: One issue per (family, muscle or day): weekly_volume + weekly_band, low_frequency + effective_frequency, missing_stretch + stretch_share collapse to the highest score.

exclude_kinds.note: info-state issues and excluded sources never appear on the program-check card; they stay in the full analysis

no_fix_action.note: show the issue with a link to its Analysis item (analysis_item) instead of Apply; no Apply / Undo ops. Not dropped: there is no minimum score on the card.

check_priority.action: apply when fix is set, else no_fix_action.action
check_priority.apply: Each issue carries fix = the best validated fix (resolving first, then fewest ops): ops (swap / add / sets / move as analysis.py apply_ops diff), preview, resolves, and undo ops (invert_ops).
